weight_identity_policy.preflight: Small files hashed and historical markers matched; safetensors size checked only, not current weight-content validation.
weight_identity_policy.per_stage: Single SHA sweep of current model files inside240s stage /1200s campaign, before and after complete stat identity: symlink target,resolvedpath,dev,inode,size,mtime_ns,ctime_ns. No automatic full-model rescan.
weight_identity_policy.base: Original pin is historical; original shard expected SHA is unavailable. Capture new base shard SHA once at base stage; retain as newly captured identity rather than historical identity.
weight_identity_policy.checkpoint: Compare one stage SHA sweep to historical prefix-complete expected values; model_only checkpoints25/50 are authorized for inference.

boundary: File-only preparation. No model/processor/tokenizer load, no GPU generation/training, no claim that weight hashes passed during small-file preflight.
